description: Both world maps: location scrolling, page bounds, Tethealla opening, multiple visited shops, item panels and final return.
registration: Rust inventory-fixture grants both maps, records all 55 listed locations and shops 1–51 in copies of the Items handoff fixture. These are controlled menu fixtures, not story/travel evidence. Native update 64 is source VI zero with the observed independent field/UI origins and no loading-clock adjustment. Inputs check nested fades, ignored early input, item row scrolling and page jumps. Whole-frame tolerance remains 8/1%; world_map_state compares navigation, page/popup fades, description state, post-draw scroll counters and UI time. This second route checks location scrolling and paging through the final Sylvarant row, then opens Tethealla and visits multiple shops in Meltokio and Sybak. VIs 1228 have no video presentation and are omitted based on ffprobe timestamps.
